description: Source code for the Emergency Access Daemon (ead), implementing network packet handling, authentication, and server management functionalities.

classes.name: ead_instance
classes.description: Represents an instance of the ead server with network interface and bridge configuration.

methods.name: set_recv_type
methods.description: Configures the socket to receive packets of a specific type on Linux.

methods.name: ead_open_pcap
methods.description: Creates and configures a pcap handle for capturing packets on a specified interface.

methods.name: get_random_bytes
methods.description: Fills a buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes from /dev/urandom.

methods.name: prepare_password
methods.description: Reads and hashes user passwords from the password file, preparing authentication data.

methods.name: chksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum for IP/UDP headers.

methods.name: ead_send_packet_clone
methods.description: Clones and sends a network packet, recalculating IP and UDP checksums.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Transitions the server state machine to a new state, initializing necessary components.

methods.name: handle_ping
methods.description: Handles ping messages, responding with server info.

methods.name: handle_set_username
methods.description: Processes username setting requests from clients.

methods.name: handle_get_prime
methods.description: Handles requests to provide cryptographic prime and salt data.

methods.name: handle_send_a
methods.description: Processes the client's public key exchange step.

methods.name: handle_send_auth
methods.description: Verifies client authentication and proceeds to command exchange.

methods.name: handle_send_cmd
methods.description: Executes received commands, manages process forking, and streams output.

methods.name: parse_message
methods.description: Parses incoming network messages and dispatches to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: handle_packet
methods.description: Processes captured network packets, filtering and passing valid packets for parsing.

methods.name: ead_pcap_reopen
methods.description: Reopens pcap handles, applying filters and handling interface changes.

methods.name: ead_pktloop
methods.description: Main packet processing loop, dispatching captured packets.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the daemon.

methods.name: server_handle_sigchld
methods.description: Handles SIGCHLD signals to clean up child processes.

methods.name: instance_handle_sigchld
methods.description: Handles SIGCHLD signals for child process termination.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts a server instance, optionally forking into background.

methods.name: start_servers
methods.description: Starts all configured server instances.

methods.name: stop_server
methods.description: Stops a server instance and optionally frees its resources.

methods.name: server_handle_sigint
methods.description: Handles SIGINT to gracefully shut down all server instances.

methods.name: check_bridge_port
methods.description: Associates network interfaces with bridges based on port information.

methods.name: check_bridge
methods.description: Iterates over bridge ports to verify and assign interfaces.

methods.name: check_all_interfaces
methods.description: Checks and updates the status of all network interfaces and bridges.
